concerns.text: FR-003 mandates exactly 1,000 episodes per (Tier, Threshold) combination. Task T024 only specifies 'a sufficient number' and T023 'uniform steps' without explicitly enforcing the 1,000 count or the 0.0–1.0 sweep range, leaving the statistical power requirement unimplemented.

SC-001 and SC-004 require fitting a quadratic regression and running an ANOVA to measure statistical significance (p < 0.05). Task T028 mentions 'Linear/Quadratic' regression but lacks a specific task to implement the ANOVA test and significance validation logic required to satisfy these success criteria.

SC-002 requires calculating a 'distillation cost-benefit ratio' by comparing log-probability shifts against task completion. Task T030 relies on 'mean log-probability shift (from T021)', but T021 only promises 'logging' of shifts, not the aggregation/calculation of the mean metric required for the ratio formula.

FR-004 defines 'policy rigidity' as residual variance after regressing out the threshold effect. While T028 implements regression, there is no explicit task to calculate the *residual* variance specifically for the 'policy rigidity' metric, risking the implementation of raw variance instead.

Task T015 mandates 'mandatory caching logic' for generated graphs. This conflicts with the Plan and Constitution (Principle I & III) which state graphs should be 'regenerated on-the-fly' or fetched from a canonical source to ensure reproducibility. The task description needs to be revised to align with the seed-based regeneration strategy rather than static caching.
